releases.notes: Mistral Large 2411 (the Nov 2024 24.11 point release, 'Mistral Large 2.1') is not recorded as a separate entry: it shipped alongside the Pixtral Large announcement without its own dedicated launch post, only a model-card page. GSM8K, MATH and HumanEval scores could not be added: the launch post ('Large Enough') renders its code, reasoning and math benchmark results only as chart images with no extractable numeric text (re-checked 2026-09-07), and the gated Hugging Face model card (mistralai/Mistral-Large-Instruct-2407) requires authentication so its README could not be fetched anonymously.

releases.name: Mistral Large 3

announcement.title: Introducing Mistral 3
announcement.quote: Mistral 3 includes three state-of-the-art small, dense models (14B, 8B, and 3B) and Mistral Large 3 – our most capable model to date – a sparse mixture-of-experts trained with 41B active and 675B total parameters.

sources.note: README contains tool-use/function-calling code examples only, no benchmark table.

sources.title: Mistral Large 3 — model documentation
sources.note: Client-rendered docs page; no GPQA/AIME/MMLU-Pro/HLE/ARC-AGI-2/SWE-bench/MMMU/LiveCodeBench/Terminal-Bench text or table found in the fetched HTML.

releases.notes: No official numeric benchmark scores could be sourced: the launch post's performance comparisons are rendered as images only ('Chart Base Models', 'Model Performance Comparison (instruct)', GPQA Diamond chart), the model's Hugging Face README has no benchmark table, the docs.mistral.ai model page has no extractable benchmark text, and no dedicated technical report for Mistral Large 3 was found as of the retrieval date (re-checked 2026-09-07). The launch post's only readable numeric capability figure (85% on AIME '25) belongs to the separate Ministral 14B reasoning variant, a non-flagship mini tier excluded by this project's rules.
